title: Why Roman Concrete Still Stands After 2,000 Years
alt_titles: The Romans Made Better Concrete Than We Do. Why?
description:
The Pantheon's dome has stood in Rome for about 1,900 years. It has no steel inside it. Roman harbour walls have sat in seawater for two thousand years and grown stronger. Much of the concrete we pour today needs serious repair within decades. So what did the Romans know that we forgot?

In this documentary we follow the recipe from volcanic ash in the Bay of Naples to a 2023 laboratory discovery at MIT: tiny white lumps that everyone thought were mistakes, and that turned out to be the secret to concrete that seals its own cracks.
